prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1111; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain and stiffness, and the mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms. Over the course of 19 visits, care consisted of conservative management including manual therapy, stretching and strengthening exercises, and home exercise instruction. The treatment course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as the patient's range of motion and pain levels improved. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm a cervical strain consistent with the collision. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical spine has been reported or identified in the records reviewed. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated billing observed. The patient was discharged from active care in stable condition with instructions to continue the home exercise program as needed.
